Doheny Asset Management Has Upped Its B G C Partners Class A (BGCP) Position; S-R Schill & Associates Has Decreased United Parcel Service Cl B (UPS) Stake by $393,640 as Market Valuation Rose
June 27, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
S-R Schill & Associates decreased its stake in United Parcel Service Inc Cl B (UPS) by 1.13% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. S-R Schill & Associates sold 3,785 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.87% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 330,179 shares of the transportation company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $34.56 million, down from 333,964 at the end of the previous reported quarter. S-R Schill & Associates who had been investing in United Parcel Service Inc Cl B for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $94.42 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.56% or $0.62 during the last trading session, reaching $109.58. About 2.04 million shares traded. United Parcel Service, Inc. (NYSE:UPS) has risen 9.01% since June 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.56% the S&P500.
